label: Genuine request: school fees
text: Tendai my child, school fees for your cousin are due on Friday. Thank you, Grandma.

label: Scam: family member on a new number
text: Hi it's your brother, new number, send R2,000 urgently, don't tell mum.

label: Scam: prize delivery fee
text: Congratulations! You won a phone. Pay R350 delivery fee to claim it today.
